title: 第19章 不可能的复合弓弩第20章 好东西要安利给女王
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 艾尔德大师沉着脸，在一片注视中，亲手拿起了这把弓。
他搭上箭，开始拉弦。
初始的力道让他眉头一皱，心中更是不屑。
就这？就这？
这磅数，远低于他平生用过的任何一张战弓！
射出去的箭怕是连五十步外的皮甲都穿不透吧？
他已经做好了用事实来狠狠打这个无知人类脸的准备。
手中将弓弦拉开。
就在弓弦将拉满，力道达到顶点的瞬间——
奇迹发生了。
滑轮组转动到特定角度，弓弦的拉力骤然一松！
一股巨大的卸力感传来，让他差点没握住弓弦，整个人往前踉跄了一步！
原本需要百斤以上巨力才能维持的满弓状态，此刻居然只用两根手指就轻松勾住。
弓身稳如磐石。
他稳稳地瞄准了远处一块用于测试重装盔甲硬度的百炼精钢靶。
那是连巨魔的战斧都只能在上面留下一道浅痕的靶子。
艾尔德大师的瞳孔骤然收缩成一个点，整张脸写满了不可思议。
他完全不明白，手中这把名为“复合弓”的怪物，为何如此不合常理！
他带着满心的震撼与迟疑，松开了手指。
一声沉闷到极致的震响，远比普通弓弦声要短促、暴烈！
那不是木与弦的鸣唱，而是纯粹的、被压抑到极限的暴力释放！
黑色的箭矢从弓弦上消失，空气中只留下一道肉眼几乎无法捕捉的残影。
下一秒。
一声刺耳的金铁交鸣声炸响！
远处的百炼精钢靶，被那支看似普通的箭矢，从中心硬生生贯穿！
箭矢的尾羽，还在靶子后面疯狂震颤，发出“嗡嗡”的悲鸣！
整个工坊，落针可闻。
所有精灵都倒抽了一口凉气，呆滞地看着那个被洞穿的钢靶。
这箭居然有如此威力！
他们再看向那把“丑陋”的复合弓时，视线已经从质疑，转变成了狂热的震惊与崇拜！
content_en:
Master Elder calmly picked up the bow with his own hands under everyone's gaze.
He nocked the arrow and began to pull the string.
The initial strength made him frown, and he felt even more disdainful.
That's it? That's it?
This weight is far lower than any war bow he has ever used in his life!
I'm afraid the arrow that was shot couldn't even penetrate the leather armor fifty steps away, right?
He was ready to slap this ignorant human in the face with facts.
Pull the bow string out in your hand.
Just when the bow string is about to be fully drawn and the strength reaches its peak——
A miracle happened.
The pulley group rotates to a specific angle, and the tension of the bow string suddenly relaxes!
A huge sense of relief came, making him almost lose his grip on the bowstring and stagger forward!
The full bow state that originally required more than a hundred kilograms of force could be easily hooked with just two fingers.
The bow is as stable as a rock.
He steadily aimed at a hardened steel target in the distance that was used to test the hardness of heavy armor.
It was a target that even the troll's battle ax could only leave a shallow mark on.
"This...how is this possible!?"
Master Elder's pupils suddenly shrank to a point, and his whole face was filled with incredulity.
He didn't understand at all why this monster named "Compound Bow" in his hand was so unreasonable!
Full of shock and hesitation, he loosened his fingers.
"Boom——!"
An extremely dull sound, far shorter and more violent than the sound of ordinary bowstrings!
That is not the singing of wood and strings, but the pure release of violence that has been suppressed to the limit!
The black arrow disappeared from the bowstring, leaving only an afterimage in the air that was almost impossible to catch with the naked eye.
The next second.
"Cang!!!"
A harsh sound of metal and metal exploded!
The hundred-refined steel target in the distance was penetrated from the center by that seemingly ordinary arrow!
The tail feathers of the arrow were still trembling crazily behind the target, making a mournful "buzzing" sound!
Throughout the workshop, you can hear the needle drop.
All the elves gasped and stared blankly at the pierced steel target.
This arrow is actually so powerful!
When they looked at the "ugly" compound bow again, their gazes had changed from doubt to fanatical shock and admiration!
title_en: Chapter 19 The Impossible Compound Crossbow Chapter 20 Good things must be given to the Queen
